summary.text: Jon Aleckson is the Republican candidate for Wisconsin State Assembly District 50 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Bill Oemichen in a race with no incumbent.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as educator and business owner.

paragraphs.text: Aleckson graduated from Cedarburg High School and earned a Ph.D. from the University of Wisconsin–Madison in 2010, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a lifelong Wisconsinite who lives on 17 acres in the Town of Springdale and serves on the board of a Middleton free clinic.
The survey says he holds a doctorate in educational technology, has college teaching experience, has written two books on team collaboration, and has founded and grown companies.

Aleckson's survey responses call for portable low-interest mortgages for young homebuyers, doubling the homestead tax credit for seniors, and a constitutional amendment to protect seniors from property tax increases.
They also support expanding access to child care, guidelines for artificial intelligence data center development, and lowering input costs for farmers.
